title.narrative: Strengthening the indigenous organizations for the protection and environmental managament of indigenous lands

description.narrative: Strengthening of the actions, articulations and political incidence of indigenous organisations/peoples in the protection and environmental managament of indigenous lands and the defense of indigenous rights. Direct beneficiaries include CGY, Warã, Wyty Cate, UNIVAJA, theTerena Council and APOINME. Advocacy and communication carried out by CTI are also deliverables of the project.
